title: Instilling Mindfulness of Allah in Children in the Age of Modern Devices

text_simplified:
Instilling sound creed in the hearts of children strengthens the station of ihsan within them and prepares them to be mindful of Allah the Exalted in all their actions.
This internal watchfulness is especially vital today, when modern devices are widespread and can expose youth to harmful influences and grave trials. The Prophet ﷺ took great care to plant these beliefs in the hearts of the young, as in the hadith of Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) when he was behind him ﷺ.
